app_fee.value: The application fee is $40 for every graduate applicant, US or international.
app_fee.quote: Each graduate application (US or international) will be assessed a fee of $40

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver for international applicants was found. The waivers named on the tuition page are for out-of-state tuition.
fee_waiver.quote: Out-of-state students may qualify for the Bulldog Out-of-State Fee Waiver, Graduate Assistantship Out-of-State Fee Waiver

gre_general.value: The Graduate School tells applicants to check GRE rules with each program's coordinator.
gre_general.quote: Please check on GRE requirements with the coordinator of the specific graduate program(s)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 80 for graduate admission (paper-based 550).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL with a minimum score of 550 (paper-based), 80 (iBT, iBT Home Edition, or iBT Paper Edition)

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum of 6.5 overall, over four modules.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS with a minimum score of 6.5 (over 4 modules)

english_waiver.value: India is not on the university's list of countries exempt from English proof, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Louisiana Tech University classifies the following overseas countries as majority native English speaking for admission purposes and do not require proof of English Proficiency

notes: Graduate School rules from the requirements, tuition and graduate apply pages. Other accepted English tests: Duolingo 105, PTE 58, or completion of ELS Level 112. Tests must be no more than two years old. Fall international preferred deadline is July 1 (the page shows no year). Program-level GRE and funding rules come from the College of Engineering and Science catalog entry.
